why: The statement asks for the value of Λ, a single number, so anything short of determining it is a bound. Pre-2024 results are journal-published bounds (digested); Dobner's second proof of a known result and Yang's restatement move nothing (none). After the snapshot, the unconditional upper-bound claims (Mosaic v1/v2, Gomila, Kornaus, Gordon, Raymond 0.149396) are bound/unreviewed: no named human worked through any of them. Gomila's 'Romik review' is the author's account only, and AI panels and replays are not digestion. Conditional or audit-relative results (Planat, Raymond 0.116398) reduce the problem to unproven inputs and are none. The 9/32 bound is weaker than the existing 0.2, so it moves nothing and is none. The OpenAI zero-free region and the n0zer0d4y analogues are variants. Gershon and Pavesi claim RH, hence Λ = 0, which would be whole. Both are not_credible: no uptake, later bound papers in the same months still treat Λ as open, and Gershon's own abstract limits a key step to a finite range. Shree's claim that Λ ≠ 0 contradicts the known zeros of Ξ on its face and is not_credible. On AI role: Mosaic v2's abstract says 'fully AI-derived', which I read as generated, even though the record names no system. Gomila's disclosure credits Claude and ChatGPT/Codex with 'exploration, program development, testing, criticism, and manuscript revision', and the author claims the proof as his own. That disclosure does not say any piece of mathematics in the result came from a model, so I answered none. Murphy's 9/32 gets no credit for OpenAI's model, because that model's work belongs to the OpenAI event (F13).
doubts: Close calls: (1) Mosaic v2 is answered generated on the abstract sentence 'fully AI-derived', but the record's ai.systems is empty and no model is named, so ai_systems_credited is empty. (2) Gomila is none rather than assisted. 'Mathematical exploration' could hide model-produced arguments, but the disclosure names no specific contribution. (3) Raymond's 0.149396 and Gordon's repositories have none_found false with empty systems. Gordon's PROVENANCE names GPT-6 Astra as a reviewer and Claude Code as an assistant, which is not mathematics. Raymond's 0.149396 PDF was not read, so model-produced mathematics there cannot be ruled out. (4) Kornaus's year-only 2026 date is still after the snapshot. (5) Whether Raymond 0.149396 is truly unconditional rests only on the absence of a stated hypothesis on its landing page.
